description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Advertisement of Petition - Winding up of ETI Finance Limited
categorisation: This gazette content is a legal notice advertising a petition for the winding-up (liquidation) of a specific finance company, ETI Finance Limited. It deals with commercial insolvency proceedings under the Companies Act and Finance Business Act, which falls squarely within the definition of Commercial Gazettes (business dissolutions and regulatory compliance matters for financial institutions).
